data.name: Sharvuneet
data.gender_notes: Sharvuneet is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess Sharvuni, also known as Sharvani, is a form of the goddess Saraswati. She is the goddess of light, knowledge, wisdom, and learning. She is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument) and a lamp. The name Sharvuneet carries the meaning “Goddess of Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvuneet usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvuneet represents the enlightened and wise aspect of the divine feminine. She inspires us to seek knowledge, understanding, and wisdom in all aspects of our lives. She is a symbol of inner illumination and the power of the mind.
data.etymology: Sharvuneet belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvuneet total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
